A player using a Work Bench to craft a Wooden Sword.

Work Benches are a type of flat-surface furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They fulfill a house's table requirement.

There are 60 types of Work Benches which can be crafted, and 5 types which must be picked up from areas such as the Dungeon. Some Work Benches can also be found in Underground Cabins, in which they follow the theme of the cabin they are found in.

History[edit]

 Desktop version
  • Desktop 1.4.5.0:
    • Added Aetherium, Aquarium, Boulder, Cloud, Crimtane, Demonite, Duskware, Easter, Fallen Star, Feywood, Flinx Fur, Forbidden, Hallowed, Harpy, Jellyfish, Librarian, Office, Pine, Snow, Spike, and Stone Work Benches.
    • Gothic Work Benches are now craftable.
    • Lihzahrd Work Bench can now be crafted at Lihzahrd Furnaces from 10 Lihzahrd Bricks.
  • Desktop 1.4.4: Added Ash Wood, Balloon and Reef Work Benches.
  • Desktop 1.4.0.1:
    • Crafting a Work Bench for the first time now grants the player the "Benched" achievement.
    • Slime Work Bench now craftable at a Solidifier.
    • Spider, Lesion, Sandstone, Bamboo, Nebula, Solar, Stardust, Vortex Work Benches added.
    • Skyware Work Bench item and placed sprites updated.
  • Desktop 1.3.5: Golden and Crystal Work Benches are now obtainable.
  • Desktop 1.3.2: Some sprites updated.
  • Desktop 1.3.1: Golden and Crystal Work Benches added, but unobtainable.
  • Desktop 1.3.0.1:
    • Meteorite, Granite, Marble and Martian Work Benches added.
    • Skyware Work Bench now correctly requires Sky Mill to craft.
  • Desktop 1.2.4:
    • Palm Wood, Boreal Wood, Skyware, Glass and Living Wood Work Benches added.
    • Mushroom and Slime Work Bench sprites are updated.
  • Desktop 1.2.3.1: Fixed bug where Steampunk Work Bench was not craftable.
  • Desktop 1.2.3: Added Dynasty, Honey, Frozen and Steampunk variants.
  • Desktop 1.2.1: Added Pumpkin and Spooky variants.
  • Desktop 1.2: Sprite updated, now can be destroyed with a pickaxe, added Rich Mahogany, Cactus, Mushroom, Pearlwood, Ebonwood, Shadewood, Flesh, Bone, Slime, Gothic, Blue Dungeon, Green Dungeon, Pink Dungeon, Obsidian and Lihzahrd variants.
  • Desktop 1.0.6.1: No longer crafts the Bed, Bookcase, Bench, Loom, Dresser, Keg, Barrel, or Piano; those items now crafted using the Sawmill.
  • Desktop 1.0.6: Regular Work Bench sprites updated. Old item and placed sprites were
  • Desktop 1.0.5: Added tooltip.
  • Desktop-Release: Introduced.
